measurement.file_type_denominator: Git porcelain/ref outputs; gitdir, commondir, HEAD, optional locked and .git markers; filesystem lstat/iterdir
measurement.path_denominator: all Git worktree registrations, all linked admin directories, their required records and live backlinks, requested path
measurement.selector: exact branch ref AND exact worktree root; create availability or resume attachment

unresolved_by_construction.detail: No wider filesystem/mount search; missing registered directories do not prove abandonment or prune safety.
Git and filesystem reads are sequential, not an atomic snapshot; changes after or between reads can escape observation.
This read-only command reserves nothing. Root serializes commissioning, reruns immediately before creation and reads back exact attachment afterward.
Receipt does not intercept or enforce arbitrary commissioning prompts.
